name: interim-monorepo
description: Interim: between-visit AE check-in with contactless vitals as eSource (HackRU 2026, Regeneron track)

scripts.py: node -e "const cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path'),fs=require('fs');const a=process.argv.slice(1);const cwd=path.resolve(a.shift()||'.');const env=Object.assign({},process.env);while(a.length&&/^[A-Z_]+=/.test(a[0])){const kv=a.shift();const i=kv.indexOf('=');env[kv.slice(0,i)]=kv.slice(i+1);}const w=process.platform==='win32';let py=path.resolve(w?'.venv/Scripts/python.exe':'.venv/bin/python');if(!fs.existsSync(py)){py=w?'python':'python3';console.error('[py] .venv not found; falling back to '+py+' on PATH (create it: make install, or see README)');}const r=cp.spawnSync(py,a,{cwd:cwd,env:env,stdio:'inherit'});if(r.error){console.error('[py] '+r.error.message);process.exit(1);}process.exit(r.status===null?1:r.status);" --
scripts.install:all: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix apps/web ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix apps/vitals-bridge ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,bridge -c blue,green,magenta "npm run api" "npm run web" "npm run bridge"
scripts.api: npm run -s py -- apps/api -m uvicorn interim_api.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.bridge: npm --prefix apps/vitals-bridge run bridge -- --source mock --scenario resting --api http://localhost:8000 --ws-port 8787
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:api && npm run test:scripts && npm run test:bridge && npm run test:web
scripts.test:scripts: npm run -s py -- . scripts/fetch_public.py --offline --strict && npm run -s py -- scripts -m pytest -q && npm run -s py -- . scripts/synthea/import_synthea.py --check && npm run -s py -- . scripts/synthea/eval_synthea.py --check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:py: npm run lint:rules && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:scripts
scripts.lint:rules: npm run -s py -- packages/rules -m ruff check . && npm run -s py -- packages/rules -m ruff format --check . && npm run -s py -- packages/rules -m mypy --strict interim_rules
scripts.lint:api: npm run -s py -- apps/api -m ruff check . && npm run -s py -- apps/api -m ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:scripts: npm run -s py -- scripts -m ruff check . && npm run -s py -- scripts -m ruff format --check . && npm run -s py -- scripts MYPYPATH=../packages/rules -m mypy
scripts.lint:js: npm --prefix apps/vitals-bridge run lint && npm --prefix apps/vitals-bridge run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
